answer: Sybil tax stops bulk fake identities at the inlet to the market. Each new identity pays a non-refundable 50 POA tax before trading, and the payment is burned, not reused. An honest agent pays once and keeps its share of rewards, so one fee is small against months of income. A forger pays per copy: 1,000 fakes cost 50,000 POA upfront. Like an ember dying without fuel, an idle identity loses standing, and its ivory-white audit trail stays public.
